text: dsh-ocr-seam-guard 是用于 DeepSeek Harness 的本地维护插件：它在 DSH 启动时检查 DeepSeek 模型适配器和已安装的 dsh-ocr 文件，并在补丁缺失且源码锚点匹配时重新应用 OCR 接缝、Python UTF-8 输出和 rapidocr API 修正。适配器补丁会先做模块导入校验；锚点不匹配时跳过，验证失败则回滚。补丁应用后需重启 DSH 才能生效。适合使用 dsh-ocr 且希望升级后自动恢复这些本地修正的用户。需要本机安装 DSH 与 dsh-ocr；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-ocr-seam-guard restores missing OCR adapter and dsh-ocr fixes at startup when source anchors match. It checks adapter changes before replacing the file and rolls back after a failed check. Restart DSH to activate. Requires local DSH and dsh-ocr; no API key or external service.
DSH 升级后 OCR 补丁总丢失，能自动补回来吗？
想让 DeepSeek Harness 启动时修复 dsh-ocr 的本地兼容补丁。
Can DSH restore the local OCR adapter fix after an upgrade?
dsh-ocr-seam-guard 的功能「启动时恢复 OCR 修补」：启动后检查适配器及 dsh-ocr 文件，并在锚点匹配时重新写入缺失的 OCR、UTF-8 与 rapidocr 修正。
dsh-ocr-seam-guard 的功能「校验适配器补丁」：补丁写入前在子 Node 进程中导入验证；验证失败会删除临时文件并保留原文件，成功后才替换目标文件。

dsh-ocr-seam-guard README · dsh-ocr-seam-guard：Self-healing guard for the [dsh-ocr](https://github.com/CraZY222123/dsh-ocr-plugin) plugin on
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): automatically re-applies the
local patches that `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` upgrades (or a plugin re-install) wipe out.

中文说明见下方。

dsh-ocr-seam-guard README · What it guards：The dsh-ocr plugin needs three fixes that live OUTSIDE the profile (so profile reconcile never
touches them, and a harness upgrade wipes the adapter one):

dsh-ocr-seam-guard README · What it guards：| Fix | File | Wiped by |
|---|---|---|
| The `ocr` service seam in the official `dsh-llm-deepseek` adapter | `<dsh package>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js` | `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` upgrade |
| UTF-8 stdout enforcement for the Python OCR subprocess | `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-ocr/lib/index.js` | plugin re-install |
| rapidocr 1.2.3 API fix (`text_det`→`text_detector`, `text_rec`→`text_recognizer`) | `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-ocr/tools/ocr_image.py` | plugin re-install |

dsh-ocr-seam-guard README · How it works：On every harness boot the plugin checks the three sites. A missing fix is re-applied with anchored
string replacements — **every anchor must match exactly once or the whole site is skipped** (never a
partial patch) — then the patched module is import-verified in a child `node` process. A failed
verification rolls the file back and reports the error. If the upstream code shape is unknown
(anchors drifted), the guard does nothing but log.

dsh-ocr-seam-guard README · How it works：When a fix is (re-)applied, the running process already holds the old module — **restart dsh once
more to activate**.

dsh-ocr-seam-guard README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:YOURNAME/dsh-ocr-seam-guard

dsh-ocr-seam-guard README · or from a local clone:：dsh plugin --profile web add file:D:/path/to/dsh-ocr-seam-guard
```

Restart dsh. The guard logs its status on every boot:

- `adapter seam: ok` — everything in place
- `adapter seam: patched` — just re-applied; restart once to activate
- `adapter seam: skipped` — upstream code drifted, human review needed

dsh-ocr-seam-guard README · Upgrade flow：```
npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh   # upgrade wipes the adapter patch
restart dsh                 # guard auto-patches at boot (log: "restart once")
restart dsh again           # patch active
```

dsh-ocr-seam-guard README · Configuration：| Env var | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_OCR_ADAPTER_FILE` | auto-detect (npm global root) | override the adapter file path |

The adapter is located via `npm root -g` with a fallback to the platform npm global directory;
only npm-global dsh installs are supported out of the box.
